En tredjedel av sträckningen är nu färdigbyggd och jätteprojektet går in i nästa fas. – Den är mindre ful än jag hade tänkt mig, säger Pontus Block, som har fått en efterlängtad mur vid tomten.

en.title: Protection around Näset takes shape: "Hope we're spared floods"
en.summary: The protective embankments are to shield Falsterbonäset from flooding as the sea level rises. A third of the stretch is now completed and the huge project is entering its next phase. – It's less ugly than I had imagined, says Pontus Block, who has gotten a long-awaited wall by his plot.

sv.title: Örebros olycka kan bli FCR:s lycka: ”Skulle inte tacka nej”
sv.summary: Storklubben Rosengård åker ur damallsvenskan, men kan räddas kvar om Kif Örebro går i konkurs. – Skulle det bli så att vi får platsen skulle vi definitivt inte tacka nej, säger fotbollschefen Caroline Seger till Radiosporten.

en.title: Örebro's misfortune could be FCR's luck: "We wouldn't say no"
en.summary: The big club Rosengård is relegated from the women's Allsvenskan, but could be saved if Kif Örebro goes bankrupt. – If we do get the place, we would definitely not say no, says football director Caroline Seger to Radiosporten.

sv.summary: Aldrig tidigare har ett lag som vunnit SM-guld åkt ur damallsvenskan två säsonger senare. Aldrig tidigare har ett allsvenskt lag förlorat ett kval mot en klubb från elitettan. Nu har det hänt. Fast det borde inte ha hänt.

en.title: Kaxiga Crux tried to squeeze FC Rosengård out of the women's Allsvenskan
en.summary: Never before has a team that won the Swedish championship been relegated from the women's Allsvenskan two seasons later. Never before has an Allsvenskan team lost a play-off to a club from the Elitettan. Now it has happened. Though it shouldn't have happened.

sv.title: Garbo och Bergman på Varietys topp 100

en.title: Garbo and Bergman on Variety's top 100
en.summary: When the entertainment magazine Variety lists the 100 greatest film stars of all time, two Swedish names are on the list. They are Ingrid Bergman, at no. 18, and Greta Garbo, at no. 22.

sv.title: V: Ett mandat saknades – nu samlar vi stöd för ett rödgrönt styre 2030

en.title: V: One seat was missing – now we are building support for a red-green government in 2030
en.summary: There are a number of reforms that will not become reality as long as the Social Democrats govern together with right-wing parties. The Left Party's main focus will be building support for a red-green government in Lund municipality in 2030. This is according to the Left Party's two leading representatives in Lund.

sv.title: L: Våld i skolan ska leda till omplacering

en.title: Extraordinary villa in Örkelljunga gets attention from Hemnetknarkarna

en.title: Live: Snow falls over Skåne
en.summary: The first snow of the year is falling right now over western Skåne. The snowfall is expected to continue for the rest of Monday. – We have no warnings. But a high-pressure system from northern Sweden means the snow could settle, says Lisa Frost at SMHI.

sv.title: Mysteriet i Malmö: Vart har den gamla Jesusstenen tagit vägen?

en.title: Mystery in Malmö: Where has the old Jesus stone gone?
en.summary: It feels as if it has always been there. It has been described as “a natural part of the cityscape”, “self-evident” and “quite nice”. Now it has vanished without a trace, and where it once rested stands a new stone. What actually happened to the old Jesus stone?

sv.title: Familjens sorg efter Rönningemordet: Smärta varje dag

Nu tackar hennes familj för allt stöd – och vädjar om att bli lämnad ifred inför den kommande rättegången. ”Att förlora vår älskade dotter och syster är en sorg som inte går att beskriva med ord”, skriver familjen till TT.

en.title: Rönninge murder: Family's grief, pain every day
en.summary: The 25-year-old woman was abducted and murdered over the Christmas holiday last year. Now her family thanks everyone for their support – and pleads to be left in peace ahead of the upcoming trial. “Losing our beloved daughter and sister is a grief that cannot be described in words”, the family writes to TT.

sv.title: ”Socialdemokraterna i Malmö har vägrat skydda äldre i utsatta situationer.”

en.title: "The Social Democrats in Malmö have refused to protect the elderly in vulnerable situations"
en.summary: Ideological opposition to private alternatives is given more weight than the elderly's need for care, writes Albin Schyllert (M), vice chair of Malmö's health, care and elderly care committee.

sv.title: 18-åring gripen i Kroatien för mordet i Älvsjö

sv.title: Växande spricka i C om regeringsval
